rows.grounds: compound: atīndra (beyond Indra) + anekarūpa (manifold-form) + ātmā (self/nature); describes the subject
proper name of the deity Skanda
compound: para (other/enemy) + pura (city/fortress) + jaya (conqueror); epithet of the subject

items.question: Which transcendent nature and martial identity are attributed to the deity Skanda?
premises: The subject is described as beyond Indra in status.
The subject possesses a manifold-form nature.
The subject is identified as Skanda, conqueror of other cities.
items.inference: Skanda is characterized as a transcendent deity whose nature is manifold and whose power includes martial conquest.
items.plain_english: He is beyond Indra, of manifold form, Skanda, the conqueror of enemy cities.
